messages:
Sam (sec): Heads up — incoming external assessment by ACME Sec next Tue (03/12). Need to lock down scope, KMS access approach, RBAC elevation plan, and evidence retention. Assessor contact: j.doe@acme.com. Please read the intake doc: https://example.com/pt-intake
Priya (eng-sre): Got it. What access window are we offering? Prefer ephemeral roles only.
Sam (sec): Proposed window 09:00-17:00 PST. We should grant 3-hr ephemeral blocks, rotated if they need more time.
Maya (infra): We can create role acme-pt-assessor-ephem with assume-role via SSO. Will add least-privilege policy w/ time limit.
Jorge (platform): Audit logging plan: enable DEBUG on inference nodes for the window, stream to splunk index "pen-test" (retention 90d). @Priya — ok to create index?
Priya (eng-sre): Yes, will create index and retention policy. Also: for evidence delivery, presigned S3 + presigned URLs only. We should avoid giving KMS decrypt to external principals if possible.
Sam (sec): On KMS, we use a customer-managed key (alias/pt-key). We can't hand permanent decrypt perms. Options: pre-decrypt and upload, or timeboxed KMS grant. Thoughts?
Maya (infra): We can do KMS CreateGrant + GrantToken to give a timeboxed Decrypt/GenerateDataKey. Ops will revoke after window. Example: 
```
aws kms create-grant --key-id alias/pt-key
  --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/acme-pt-assessor
  --operations Decrypt GenerateDataKey
  --name pt-grant
```
Jorge (platform): Runbook pattern: create grant -> upload evidence -> generate presigned URL(s) -> revoke grant. Also capture grantId and audit it. Include SHA256 of evidence bundle.
Sam (sec): Good. For remediation tracking: GH issues with label `pt-remediation` + project board. We'll use milestone `PT-2026-03`. @Priya can you create the milestone and a checklist issue template?
Priya (eng-sre): Yep. Creating milestone and template now. Quick question on severity mapping: We map Critical -> P0, High -> P1, Medium -> P2, Low -> P3?
Jorge (platform): That mapping works. Add escalation steps for P0 (pager + war room).
Sam (sec): Retest flow: when an issue is fixed, label `ready-for-retest`, ping this channel and assign to assessor. Aim to schedule retest within 7 business days after request.
Priya (eng-sre): I'll also prepare the evidence packaging checklist: logs, traces, config snapshots, access logs, KMS grant audit entries. Template: https://short.link/pt-template
Maya (infra): Ops note — need to snapshot staging and prod logs, scrub PII before sending. Use scrubber: `/usr/local/bin/log-scrub --mask-email --mask-ssn` before packaging.
Sam (sec): Oncall please standby for live session during retest in case assessor needs help. @deploy-bot can you post tentative retest invite?
deploy-bot: Schedule created — tentative retest Thu 03/19 10:00-14:00 PST. Calendar invite posted to #eng-security.
Maya (infra): Action: created role `acme-pt-assessor-ephem`, documented assume-role steps and session duration. Added KMS grant playbook to ops runbook. (3160001200)
Priya (eng-sre): Action: splunk index `pen-test` created + GH milestone `PT-2026-03` and issue template pushed. (3160001245)
Jorge (platform): Action: runbook draft pushed — includes KMS grant flow, evidence hash checklist, retest scheduling steps. Will add escalation matrix. (3160001260)
Sam (sec): Great work. Next: sync tomorrow 09:00 PST to finalize evidence windows and retest booking. Outstanding: decide on whether to pre-decrypt any artifacts (pros/cons) — bring recommendations. :thumbsup:
